about: Places where a city document disagrees with state law or with another source, beyond a renumbered section. Each flag quotes both sides with sources. Read 2026-11-07. All flags confirmed by the Team 1 lead on 2026-11-07. Never present a flag as legal advice: the app should say 'may be out of date, confirm with the city'.

flags.city_says: authorized by the California Government Code Sections 65852.2 and 65852.22
flags.current: Renumbered by SB 477 (2024) to Government Code sections 66310-66342; see statutes.json

flags.city_says: AMC Section 18.38.015.110 requires the recordation of an owner occupancy covenant for all JADUs ... Owner occupancy is required within one of the dwelling units on the property
flags.current: 2025 change: if a JADU has shared sanitation facilities with the primary structure, owner-occupancy will be required; if it does not, owner occupancy will not be required (Gov. Code, § 66333, subd. (b))

flags.city_says: Nov 2025 checklist: 'ADU Express Program which provides one day permitting and zero design costs'
flags.current: ADU Anaheim page: ADU Express 'allows qualified single-family properties to complete the ADU review process within 1-3 days'; the Pre-Approved Plan Catalogue page adds that eligibility screening 'can take a few weeks'
